scope: one pinned L1 episode only; no shared-bank motion qualification

record.foot_slip_contact_fraction_semantics: contacting-foot samples whose world-horizontal foot-speed proxy exceeds 0.35 m/s divided by all contacting-foot samples
record.base_height_semantics: vertical root clearance above highest of nine base-scan hits; invalid scan yields zero and safety stop

slip_by_foot_and_region.region_assignment: foot_world_xy mapped to generated region bounds

family_metrics.slip_by_foot_and_region_semantics: contacting-foot samples assigned by generated region bounds; candidate coefficient is not treated as measured contact friction
